diff --git a/tests/agile/test_pricing_validation.py b/tests/agile/test_pricing_validation.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1e953c2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/agile/test_pricing_validation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+"""Tests for input validation in pricing.cost_usd."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from orgos.agile.pricing import cost_usd
+
+
+def test_zero_tokens_ok() -> None:
+    """Zero prompt and completion tokens should return 0.0."""
+    assert cost_usd("deepseek/deepseek-chat", 0, 0) == 0.0
+
+
+def test_negative_prompt_raises() -> None:
+    """Negative prompt_tokens should raise ValueError."""
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="token counts must be >= 0"):
+        cost_usd("deepseek/deepseek-chat", -1, 0)
+
+
+def test_negative_completion_raises() -> None:
+    """Negative completion_tokens should raise ValueError."""
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="token counts must be >= 0"):
+        cost_usd("deepseek/deepseek-chat", 0, -5)
